text: 金十数据9月17日讯，9月16日，海南省在香港发行离岸人民币地方政府债券，这是海南省政府连续第五年在香港发行离岸人民币地方政府债券，也是海南自贸港全岛封关运作后首次发行离岸人民币债券。本次发行主要面向亚洲、欧洲投资者，共吸引8个国家和地区的59家机构投资者积极参与。据了解，此次海南省在香港发行50亿元离岸人民币地方政府债券，其中，3年期25亿元，5年期15亿元，10年期10亿元，定价利率分别为1.41%、1.51%和1.81%。峰值订单规模达437亿元，超过历年水平，是发行规模的近9倍。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 17 — On September 16, Hainan Province issued offshore RMB local government bonds in Hong Kong. This is the fifth consecutive year that the Hainan provincial government has issued offshore RMB local government bonds in Hong Kong, and also the first offshore RMB bond issuance after the Hainan Free Trade Port's full island closure operation. This issuance was mainly aimed at Asian and European investors, attracting active participation from 59 institutional investors across 8 countries and regions. It is understood that Hainan Province issued 5 billion yuan in offshore RMB local government bonds in Hong Kong, including 2.5 billion yuan for 3-year, 1.5 billion yuan for 5-year, and 1 billion yuan for 10-year, with pricing rates of 1.41%, 1.51%, and 1.81% respectively. Peak order size reached 43.7 billion yuan, exceeding historical levels and nearly 9 times the issuance size.
